facts.fact: WFP says it is supporting the Commissariat a la Securite Alimentaire in a lessons-learned exercise on the 2025 use of the RSU (Unified Social Registry) for targeting within the national food insecurity response.

WFP says it is financing data collection in 14 chronically food-insecure communes to expand the RSU with an additional 3,000 vulnerable households, and that RSU-based targeting is to be scaled up progressively nationwide.
